title: Lamb Doner Wrap
description: A classic Turkish-inspired wrap filled with juicy lamb and crunchy slaw. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with lamb seasoning.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the slaw by combining cucumber, tomato, red onion, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
Warm the pita bread in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Slice the cooked lamb into thin strips.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of slaw on each pita, followed by lamb strips.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and serve.
